title: Resource Hub
body:
The Resource Hub is a primary location and an important aspect of gameplay. Speaking to Jer Junkman will allow the player to sell any of their resources that they have placed within the checkered yellow lines for convenience. Selling your goods in the fireplaces located on either side of the Resource Hub avoids this tax. Speaking to Rej Junkman will allow the player to expand their property and buy basement for $125,000.

Material prices in the game dynamically update every 6 hours (00:00, 6:00, 12:00, 18:00 EST) according to the in-game stock market. If a large number of players sell a particular material, the increased supply causes its price to drop. For the list of in-game materials can be sell click here.

Trivia

  • The Resource Hub was added during the map revamp (Version 1.37.0), and completely replaced Jer's Junkyard as well as the selling bins alongside the Oak Depot
  • Unlike selling at either of the previous locations, resources sold here will not experience any gain/loss in price depending on whether they are wood or stone/ore
  • Behind Jer Junkman, there is a fake floor. Upon entering, you will see a bunker. In the first section, there is a hologram in the middle. On the left, there is a Floord Putter, Joop Barrow, Sellner Explorer, and Oakmobile, each on a shelf. In the second section, on the right, there are 3 screens with a Reinforced Axe piercing the middle screen. On the top, it says THE (super cool and awesome) INDEX. On the left, there is a giant stone hotdog, rat, buff moai, an axe in a pot, and a pig head.
